description: The DuckDB provider on both hosts (T1.11b): each fetch is planned by the core's data layer for DuckDB, answered by the host's DuckDB provider, admitted, and echoed back by the test-only fetch; both hosts' tests hold the admitted data to these expectations. 'several' is a result the driver hands over in batches of batch_rows; 'empty' keeps its schema with no rows; 'time_bounds' reads a TIMESTAMPTZ column as CAST(column AS TIMESTAMP), which under the zone 'zone' sets both hosts' DuckDB answer in America/New_York's wall clock, as counts of microseconds. The provider reads each request on its own cursor, as the reference's reads do, and a cursor takes the database's zone, not a session's: under 'session_zone' alone, set on the source's connection, both hosts read as with no zone set, in the host's own.
setup: CREATE TABLE many AS SELECT i::BIGINT AS n, 'r' || i AS name FROM range(5000) t(i)
CREATE TABLE nothing (n BIGINT, name VARCHAR)
